name: Janit B
tagline: I like the last mile: turning a trained model into something someone can actually use.
about: I'm a final-year Computer Science undergraduate at VIT Chennai, specialising in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. I build AI systems end to end: preparing the data, training or fine-tuning the model, wrapping it in an API, and shipping an interface people can actually use.

I care about the last mile — the part where a trained model turns into something a person can open, upload their own file to, and get a useful answer from. That is what every project on this site does.
highlights: Trained and fine-tuned deep-learning models (ResNet50, LSTM, transformers) for vision, audio and time-series problems.
Built retrieval-augmented (RAG) pipelines with LangChain, FAISS and Whisper for search over documents and meetings.
Ship full-stack around the model: FastAPI services, streaming responses, React interfaces, and tests.
Report results honestly: per-class accuracy, known weaknesses and limitations alongside the headline score.
Industry experience building AI voice agents and automations that ran for real e-commerce customers.

experience.about: Software and AI-automation studio in Bangalore that builds websites, SaaS platforms, internal tools and AI agents for D2C and retail brands.

Customised and maintained client Shopify storefronts: new features, bug fixes and ongoing store upkeep.
Worked with a cross-functional team on production client work, from first requirement to deployed feature.
